type: Vocabulary source gap research, not content authoring

sources.scope: Only Starter, Elementary1, Elementary2, factual written form/reading/coordinates; PreIntermediate excluded for this N5/N4 proposal
sources.use: Private membership comparison. All rights reserved; no translations, accent tables, explanations, workbook arrangement, audio or illustrations copied into app. Free related teaching-material use has conditions; no blanket open-data/commercial license inferred.

sources.origin: 3A Network Minna no Nihongo Shokyu I/II second edition
sources.scope: Published adult beginner communication goals,25lessons each, broad functional sequence1-50 from frozen R1 reference. Approx1000vocab each is publisher breadth context, NOT an official JLPT count or exact membership audit.
sources.use: Scope/order references only; no copyrighted vocabulary list, textbook translation, explanation or example reproduced. Lesson links are project pedagogical proposals, not claims every item is listed in that textbook.

sources.origin: EDRDG independently maintained lexical dictionary; JSON conversion scriptin
sources.rights: CC BY-SA4.0, EDRDG local licence.html; preserve attribution and share-alike for derived dictionary data as applicable.
sources.scope: Check exact spelling+reading, candidate entryIds and common-form booleans. No Vietnamese meaning or sense approval. common does not imply N5/N4, rank, everyday necessity, or all senses common.

sources.origin: OpenJLPT community project; N5/N4 membership derives from the Jonathan Waller community lists, with JMdict/KANJIDIC2/Tatoeba data in the project pipeline
sources.rights: OpenJLPT data CC BY-SA 4.0; attribute the project and preserve applicable share-alike terms. Upstream Waller list is CC BY; JMdict/KANJIDIC2 and Tatoeba entries have their own stated terms.
sources.scope: Community-estimated N5/N4 membership only; not an official JLPT syllabus or exact Minna word list. Use IDs/spelling/reading for crosswalk, not OpenJLPT English meanings or Tatoeba examples as project-authored content.

selectionOrigins: Jonathan Waller community JLPT vocabulary lists, distributed in OpenJLPT
independence.dictionaryOrigin: EDRDG lexical verification is a different editorial process, not an independent curriculum vote. OpenJLPT uses JMdict for lexical identity, so its membership/level evidence is not independent of JMdict on that dimension.
independence.limits: Irodori and Waller/OpenJLPT now provide two independently maintained N5/N4 vocabulary reference families, but their different scope and substantial disagreements require item-level decisions. Minna exact list was not available/replicated; Minna lesson links remain functional mappings only. Irodori translations, Marugoto and JF mirrors do not count as independent selection families.

openJlptCrosswalk.warning: OpenJLPT is an estimated community list. Level disagreement is evidence to review, not proof either source is correct.

provisionalSurfaceUnion.warning: Surface keys include fixed expressions; these are not certified canonical headword totals.

limits: Project N5/N4 placements are provisional functional stages, not official JLPT word membership.
